run_when: The rules found a marketplace clue (Stripe Connect) or nothing either way.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company runs a marketplace: a platform where third parties (sellers, hosts, freelancers, providers) sell to buyers and the company takes a cut or splits payments.
prompt.definition: Exclusions need positive evidence. Payment splits are unsupported today (services ICP). A company selling its own product or service is not a marketplace.
yes_when: The company calls itself a marketplace
It connects buyers and sellers (or hosts and guests, clients and freelancers) and takes a fee or commission
no_when: The company sells its own software, product or service directly
unknown_when: A platform where it's unclear whether third parties sell through it
watch_out_for: 'Available on the AWS / Salesforce / Shopify marketplace' describes where they list, not what they are
An 'integrations marketplace' inside a software product is not a marketplace business
Stripe Connect alone is only a clue: software platforms also use it for payouts

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

web_search.why: What the company is comes from its own site; web pages describe it less reliably.
